evidence.reason: Diagnosed against a live incident and confirmed against the schema. On 2026-07-27 a claude-sonnet-5 invocation in COMP-0038 returned over HTTP without exception and produced no text block: the entire 16000-token output budget was consumed generating reasoning tokens, stop_reason was max_tokens, and output_tokens equalled the limit. The invocation was recorded as INV-b59b93ec9cd8dbe6 with status success. Compared field for field against INV-c9fecfbf0964c1d2, the COMP-0037 claude-sonnet-5 invocation that produced a complete review, the two records are identical on status, governance_marker, execution_profile and spawned, differing only in invocation_id, occurred_at, session_id and input digest. Reproduced twice against a prompt whose sha256 matches the recorded rendered_prompt_digest. INVOCATION_STATUSES is frozenset({success, failure}) at invocation_record.py line 93; the record schema carries no stop_reason and no output-token count; output_token_limit is request-side only.

name: InvocationRecord cannot represent execution outcome, so a record may assert an outcome that did not occur
notes: This is GAP-0005's own stated risk recurring inside GAP-0005's remediation. GAP-0005 names truncations first among the undisclosed execution conditions invocation provenance was meant to expose, citing COMP-0032's truncation incident. CAP-0015 is that remediation, and COMP-0038 shows the same class of failure remains invisible after the fact, now with a record asserting success over it.

It is also the same class as COMP-0032, which WARR-20260722-0001 addressed by raising the output limit from 4096. Raising a limit reduces how often exhaustion occurs; it does not make exhaustion representable. COMP-0038 exhausted 16000.

Raising the limit further does not work on the current path. At max_tokens 32000 the Anthropic SDK refuses before dispatch with 'Streaming is required for operations that may take longer than 10 minutes'. That is a client-side duration guard, not a token ceiling, so no value of max_tokens resolves exhaustion without a streaming adapter.

The practical mitigation now in use is a pre-flight probe against the largest prompt of a round, whose success criterion is completion, not the presence of text: a response with stop_reason max_tokens is truncated regardless of how much text it contains. This is an operator practice outside the governed path and produces no InvocationRecord. It reduces incidence; it does not close the gap.

Every artifact produced since this diagnosis carries the caveat that absence of truncation is observed from response content only, because the record cannot report it. That caveat appears in comp0039/MANIFEST.json and in comp0039/SLICE_C_FINDINGS.md.
recommended_first_slice: Additive outcome capture only, with no change to INVOCATION_STATUSES. Add an outcome object to InvocationRecord carrying stop_reason, output_tokens, and the content block types returned, populated on the scripts/compare_providers.py path. This makes the distinction between a completed response, a truncated response, and a response with no content legible without redefining status, and therefore requires no migration of existing records: records captured before the change simply lack the object, which is accurate, since their outcomes were not captured. Redefining INVOCATION_STATUSES to admit a third value is migration-required in the sense COMP-0046 identified, because previously persisted records asserting success would need re-adjudication, and no schema-versioning or migration policy exists for self-model records. That decision should be taken separately and explicitly rather than folded into a capture change.
risk: A governed record asserts an outcome that did not occur. INVOCATION_STATUSES admits only success and failure, so an invocation that returned without exception and produced nothing had no true value available and was recorded as success. Any consumer reading status, and any audit counting successful invocations, is misled, and no field in the record discriminates the two cases. Separately, execution_profile records supplied rather than effective configuration: reasoning_parameters is {} because no effort parameter was sent, which is accurate about the request and conceals that the call ran at the provider's default effort of high, the parameter that explains the outcome. Separately again, output_token_limit is 16000 for claude-sonnet-5 with max_tokens_source settings_default, and null for gpt-5.6-terra with max_tokens_source provider_default_unset: AI-Lab caps one witness and not the other, whatever default the other endpoint applies is not recorded, and so no comparison round's records can establish that its two witnesses had comparable room to answer. This asymmetry is present in COMP-0037 and every round since and is disclosed in none of them.
summary: CAP-0015 captures which invocation occurred, under what requested configuration, over what declared inputs. It does not capture what happened when the invocation ran. The schema has no stop_reason, no output-token count, and no status value for an invocation that returned successfully and produced no content, so such an invocation is recorded as success and is field-identical to one that produced a complete review. It records supplied rather than effective configuration, so a parameter that was defaulted by the provider rather than sent is invisible even when it determines the outcome. And it records a per-provider output limit without recording the other provider's effective limit, so the comparability of two witnesses in a round cannot be established from the records.
